transformations.description: Gets the Parent Job Log ID from the Job_Logs table using the Parent Job ID
transformations.name: lkp_Parent_Job_Log_ID

transformations.description: Find if there are any failures in the Job logs to determine the next retry iteration number
transformations.name: lkp_Failed_Tasks

transformations.description: Find if there are any completed tasks in the Job logs. if there are we can skip the run of this task by not writing out a record to the task logs - the CTF taskflow will skip to the end if no records are written to the TASK_LOGS table
transformations.name: lkp_Completed_Tasks
